verdict.rationale: Asana's own docs confirm a native Rules feature with rule actions that developers can extend through app components, and they describe AI Studio as 'powerful no-code automations'. The PagerDuty listing also shows Rules automatically firing actions. Third-party tools such as Zapier and n8n earn no credit. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of trigger types and the rule-builder (trigger → condition → action) workflow, depth of the native rules engine, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can build trigger-and-action automation rules to eliminate repetitive manual steps

citations.quote: Automate tedious work in powerful, bespoke ways with our platform features like rule actions, webhooks, and our API.
Build app components on the surface of tasks or rules so that customers can use their favorite tools and stay in flow.
